constraints.name: area_fraction_range
constraints.description: Reported per item; the released data spans roughly 0.005 to 1.0. Informational only; the strict constraint is the IoU upper bound below.

constraints.name: evidence_sham_iou_max
constraints.description: Sham region must have IoU <= 0.10 with the evidence region.

constraints.name: area_match_tolerance
constraints.description: Sham region area must be within +/- 20% of the evidence region area (relative).
